prompt_text: Camera: ARRI Alexa Mini, Anamorphic, oval bokeh, stretched flares, strong highlight bloom | cool-toned digital texture with pronounced highlight bloom and horizontal anamorphic flare streaks | 40mm, f/2.0. Camera Style: Aggressive erratic handheld with one whip-pan snap and one brief macro intrusion, no slow motion, no smooth stabilized glides, no perfectly locked symmetry. Light: Hostile diegetic sources — buzzing fluorescent ceiling panel top-down, mirror-side strip underlighting the face, doubled highlights in the glass and chrome, corners dropping toward blue-black, no daylight. Style & Mood: Neon-Gothic split-tone: bruised magentas, cyan/morgue-blue, sodium-amber pockets, kept cool overall. Late-night dorm sterility that feels unsafe, with the fluorescent buzz as a pressure layer. Acting: micro-pauses before reactions, precise eye-line, wet living eyes with catch-lights, visible breath and chest rise. Narrative Summary: Lead Girl fights to keep control at a dorm sink as the infection shows itself in the mirror and a black tear appears. Scene Setup: Dorm bathroom — narrow tiled room with a long sink counter and wall mirror, chrome faucets, paper towel dispenser, stall doors deeper in the room, a floor drain near the sinks, damp smears on tile. Buzzing fluorescent ceiling panel plus mirror-side strip light create harsh doubled highlights. Camera 8 feet behind and slightly left of Lead Girl, eye-level, 40mm wide framing that includes her hunched at the sink and her face in the mirror; camera faces the mirror wall, stalls sit behind her. Lead Girl’s hands are already gripping the sink rim; faucet is off; no items in her hands; exactly one Lead Girl. First frame state: eyes molten gold; no tear streak; register: infected shock. Dynamic Description: 24mm wide, eye-level, erratic handheld; the flickering fluorescent and mirror strip strobe across wet porcelain as Lead Girl hunches over the sink, knuckles locked on the rim, eyes molten gold and wide, breath trying to slow but catching. Hard Cut to 90mm macro; her fingers crush the sink edge, nails biting, a tiny tremor running through her hand as the fluorescent buzz spikes. Hard Cut to 50mm mirror-first MCU; her reflection holds her molten-gold stare, jaw slightly slack, then lags half a second behind as she starts to turn. Whip-pan from her lagging mirror image to her real face as she completes the turn, the framing snapping onto her actual eyes. Hard Cut to 85mm tight insert at the sink line; her grip clamps harder, tendon in her wrist jumps once, and her breathing stops for a beat. Hard Cut to 75mm CU, eye-level on her cheek and eyes; a single black tear of blood swells at the lower lid and tracks down her cheek in a slow, unbroken line as she freezes, stunned — brow cinches, a slow blink sticks halfway, throat works once, the face of someone watching a dark stain spread through clean fabric; her breath releases in short, panicked pulls while the black streak remains visible. Audio: Fluorescent hum and intermittent buzz, distant dorm plumbing, a faint water drip in the room, cloth rustle as she braces, tight uneven breathing, small ceramic creak under her grip. Positive Locks: Lead Girl remains a late-teen girl with shoulder-length dark hair and pale skin, eyes molten gold, hunched at the sink. The black tear streak is a single dark track down her cheek by the end of the clip. Cool Neon-Gothic split-tone persists with bruised magentas and cyan/morgue-blue under hostile fluorescent light. Same dorm bathroom geometry with the long mirror, sink counter, chrome faucets, and stall doors in the background. No subtitles. No text overlay. No captions. No title cards. No watermarks.
